title: Adopter completes the documented tier-1 bootstrap
summary: A clean adopter follows the supported tier-1 bootstrap using factual released-tool instructions and reaches the documented doctor checkpoint without hidden prerequisites.

postconditions: The adopter has a valid supported DEVAI bootstrap

Documented released package and package-manager versions match the repository's supported declarations.
